definition.en: The National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) is a comprehensive, multi-year infrastructure investment program designed to improve the quality of life for all citizens by providing world-class infrastructure across the country.
definition.hi: The National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) is a comprehensive, multi-year infrastructure investment program designed to improve the quality of life for all citizens by providing world-class infrastructure across the country.

importanceInUpsc.en: NIP is a critical topic for UPSC GS-3 as it directly relates to infrastructure development, economic growth, and fiscal policy. Understanding its implementation, funding mechanisms, and impact on the Indian economy is essential for both Prelims and Mains.
